title: TRAIN SNAKE
oneLiner: Guide a growing train through the station without smashing into yourself or the walls.
mechanics: Steer the locomotive around the one-screen track grid.
Collect cargo cars to grow longer and earn points.
Avoid the walls and your own train cars.
The train moves faster as more cargo is collected.

controls.a: Sound the whistle for a brief speed burst

lose: The game ends when the train hits a wall or its own cars.
scoring: Earn points and add a car for each cargo crate collected.
